examples.arabic: بعد قليل، سمعوا صوت سيارة أبيهم.
examples.english: After a little while, they heard the sound of their father's car.
examples.transliteration: Ba'da qaleel, sami'u sawta sayyarati abeehim.
examples.storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

examples.arabic: احمد قال شكرا لكم هذه كتب رائعة لكنه كان يريد سيارة جديدة
examples.english: Ahmed said "Thank you! These are wonderful books!" but he wanted a new car.
examples.transliteration: Ahmed qala shukran lakum hadhihi kutub ra'i'ah lakinahu kana yureed sayyarah jadeedah

examples.arabic: سيسافرون بالسيارة يوم السبت وهم متحمسون للوقت الجميل معا.
examples.english: They will travel by car on Saturday and are excited for the beautiful time together.
examples.transliteration: Sa-yusafiroona bil-sayyarati yawm al-sabti wa hum mutahammisoon li-l-waqtil jameeli ma'an.

examples.english: He asks: Where is the car?
